HTML
<div class="zak-audio-playlist">
  <div class="zak-audio-playlist-header">Focus Mix</div>
  <ul class="zak-audio-playlist-tracklist">
    <li class="zak-audio-track is-active">
      <button class="zak-audio-track-btn"></button>
      <div><strong>Deep Focus</strong><span>4:02</span></div>
    </li>
    ...
  </ul>
</div>
JS
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-audio-track').forEach((track) => {
  track.querySelector('.zak-audio-track-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.zak-audio-track').forEach((t) => t.classList.remove('is-active'));
    track.classList.add('is-active');
  });
});

  <div class="zak-audio-waveform-bar" style="height:60%;"></div>

  ...
</div>
JS
// Animate bars with the Web Audio API for a live visualisation:
const bars = document.querySelectorAll('.zak-audio-waveform-bar');
function updateBars(dataArray) {
  bars.forEach((bar, i) => {
    bar.style.height = (dataArray[i] / 255) * 100 + '%';
  });
}
// Call updateBars inside an AnalyserNode 'requestAnimationFrame' loop.

Class Description
.zak-audioBase audio element
.zak-audio-customCustom-styled player container
.zak-audio-artworkArtwork/cover thumbnail
.zak-audio-infoTrack title and subtitle
.zak-audio-playPlay/pause button
.zak-audio-progressProgress bar track
.zak-audio-progress-barFilled progress segment
.zak-audio-playlistPlaylist container
.zak-audio-playlist-tracklistTrack list

.zak-audio-waveformWaveform visualization container
.zak-audio-waveform-barSingle waveform bar

Accessibility

  • Each audio element benefits from a <track kind="captions"> or a visible transcript for dialogue.
  • Custom play/pause buttons need aria-label and toggle between "Play" and "Pause".
  • The currently playing playlist item should be announced with aria-current="true".
  • Waveform visualizations should be aria-hidden="true" since they provide no distinct audio info.
  • Never autoplay audio; users must be able to control volume and pause at any time.
